description: A first ARQ segment that stretches the transmission past the configured length is cut so its D_PDU leaves room in its last block for the modem's end-of-message marker; cut at the block boundary, the marker would add a block.
note: As dts-tx-block-align-ed4 up to its data transmission, with modem.eom_bytes 4 and dts.max_transmission_ms 5550, one block: 40-byte blocks carry 36 bytes once the marker has its room, and a burst of m bytes takes ceil((m + 4) / 40) blocks (corpus-format.md 5; interp C-1290). Everything before 108000 is unchanged: the 25-byte request needs one block. At 108000 the first segment at the maximum segment size, 30 bytes, is a 49-byte DATA-ONLY, which does not fit the 36 bytes the limit allows, so the transmission is stretched for it to ceil((49 + 4) / 40) = 2 blocks (C-0551, C-1042). It crosses the block boundary at 40 and is not the last segment, so towards the Ed4 peer it is cut (C-0553, C-1155); ending at 40 it would still need two blocks, since the marker would take a second, so it is cut to end where one block's room ends, 36 bytes, a 17-byte segment (interp C-1290). It now needs one block, so the transmission is one block, the configured length, and nothing else fits (C-1042, C-1155). FSN 0, C_PDU START, TX WIN UWE and TX WIN LWE, since it is the only FSN allocated (C-0176, C-0185, C-0186, C-1122), DELIVER IN ORDER as the SIS asked, EOW CAPABILITY (C-1260), EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043). No room is left for fill (C-1154). The transmission lasts 5550 ms and ends at 113550, when dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with dts.ack_wait_ms 60000; the other 33 bytes of the C_PDU are still queued, so csma.lbt_wait starts with lbt_wait_vdcd_ms 3000 after the own transmission (K-0074). Without the marker's room it would have been the 40-byte D_PDU and two blocks, 10350 ms, past the limit.
